name: How long does a typical bathtub installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical bathtub installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a bathtub installation varies depending on the project's complexity. A simple like-for-like replacement in an existing space might take 1-2 days. However, projects involving reconfiguring plumbing, modifying the bathroom layout, or installing a new type of tub (like a freestanding tub replacing a built-in one) could extend to 3-5 days or more. This timeframe includes removal of the old tub, preparation of the area, installation, and finishing work like tiling or caulking.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical installation can take 1-2 days for a simple replacement, or 3-5 days for more complex projects involving plumbing or layout changes.
